name: fix-and-doc
description: Understand one reported bug, fix that instance, then record a short lesson so later changes avoid the same mistake.

inputs.name: bug-report
inputs.description: Unstructured bug report (sentence, failing case, review comment, stack trace, or tool finding).

inputs.name: lesson-path
inputs.description: Optional relative path to the pitfalls guide. When omitted, pitfall-recorder discovers or creates the guide.

outputs.name: lesson-path
outputs.description: Path of the file that received the lesson.

outputs.name: lesson-id
outputs.description: Stable slug of the lesson section.
